newsitem.title: USA: Omnicom unit wins $30 mln Samsonite account.
newsitem.headline: Omnicom unit wins $30 mln Samsonite account.

text.p: Samsonite Corp said it awarded its $30 milllion global advertising account to Omnicom Group Inc's TBWA Chiat/Day, which will be responsible for the company's Samsonite, American Tourister and Lark brands.
The account, which had been held by Leo Burnett in the U.S. for the past decade and by various agencies in Europe, will be handled by TBWA's Los Angeles office.
Also pitching the account were WPP Group Plc's J. Walter Thompson, Omnicom's DDB Needham and Interpublic Group of Cos Inc's McCann-Erickson.
